genre_target: IELTS Task 1 流程图（Process Diagram）/ 论文系统工程 Pipeline 描述段
domain_context: 长序列 Transformer 稀疏注意力与分块表征
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 工艺/自然循环流程图（或论文算法数据预处理与闭环训练流水线）：把 5–6 个串联、分叉与回环步骤写得层次分明，绝不机械连用 Then, Then, Then。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【IELTS Task 1 流程图（Process Diagram）/ 论文系统工程 Pipeline 描述段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 工艺/自然循环流程图（或论文算法数据预处理与闭环训练流水线）：把 5–6 个串联、分叉与回环步骤写得层次分明，绝不机械连用 Then, Then, Then。”。请严格按照 `BP29` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L029`（篇章级去 AI 味手术：砍掉空洞修辞外壳，直奔命题内核（Zero AI-ese Discourse Surgery）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: First, raw data is collected. Then it is cleaned. Then it goes into two branches. Branch 1 does A, and Branch 2 does B. Then they are combined. Finally, bad samples go back to the beginning.
structural_constraints: S1 [流程总括与起止界定 Lifecycle Overview]：The diagram illustrates the closed-loop pipeline for [Process Name], comprising [N] main stages from initial [Input Stage] to continuous [Feedback/Output Stage].
S2 [前段采集与预处理 Initial Ingestion & Filtering]：The process begins when raw [Material/Data] is collected via [Source] and passed through [Filter/Chamber] to remove [Impurities/Outliers].
S3 [中段并行分流 Parallel Branching]：Once purified, the stream bifurcates into two parallel pathways: [Fraction A] undergoes [Process A], whereas [Fraction B] is routed to [Process B].

S4 [末端合成与闭环回流 Synthesis & Closed-Loop Recycling]：The resulting outputs are subsequently merged in [Unit C], with residual by-products / high-error trajectories recycled back into the initial buffer for iterative refinement.
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

domain_context: 六级/雅思大作文：AI 自动化、教育与科研伦理

S3 [一针见血揭晓答案 Crisp Root Cause]：The culprit is a hidden stationarity assumption baked into standard attention layers.
S4 [亮出今日主旨 Talk Roadmap]：In this talk, I will show how our framework, [Model Name], breaks this bottleneck and achieves [Key Metric Gain] in real-time deployment.

genre_target: IELTS Task 1 含未来预测年份的图表 / 产业算力与能耗预测报告
domain_context: 基于扩散/流匹配的缺失时序插补与生成
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想处理同时包含过去历史数据（如 2010–2025）和未来预测数据（如 2026–2040）的图表段落，严格区分过去实测时态与未来审慎预测表达。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: Our contributions are: 1. A new model is proposed. 2. Solving the non-stationary problem. 3. Good results on datasets.
structural_constraints: S1 [历史实测轨迹 Historical Trajectory (Past Tense)]：Between [2010] and [2025], global data-center electricity demand rose steadily from [200 TWh] to [460 TWh], driven by cloud migration.
S2 [当下转折与未来加速 Projected Acceleration (Projection Verbs)]：From [2026] onward, consumption is projected to accelerate sharply, with forecasts indicating a surge to [1,050 TWh] by [2035].

S3 [结构占比重塑 Structural Shift in Projections]：Within this projected expansion, generative AI training and inference—which accounted for less than [10%] in [2023]—are anticipated to represent over [45%] of total load by [2040].
S4 [条件式审慎收尾 Conditional Hedging]：Nevertheless, energy-efficient hardware adoption is expected to moderate the growth slope during the final five years.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）

genre_target: IELTS Task 1 流程图（Process Diagram）/ 论文系统工程 Pipeline 描述段
domain_context: 长序列 Transformer 稀疏注意力与分块表征
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 工艺/自然循环流程图（或论文算法数据预处理与闭环训练流水线）：把 5–6 个串联、分叉与回环步骤写得层次分明，绝不机械连用 Then, Then, Then。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：AI_Mini_Paper 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT05 (基于整流蒸馏的单步实时机械臂轨迹生成完整小论文（RectiPolicy: Real-Time Action Chunk Generation）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP08 -> BP02 -> BP04`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: First, raw data is collected. Then it is cleaned. Then it goes into two branches. Branch 1 does A, and Branch 2 does B. Then they are combined. Finally, bad samples go back to the beginning.
structural_constraints: S1 [流程总括与起止界定 Lifecycle Overview]：The diagram illustrates the closed-loop pipeline for [Process Name], comprising [N] main stages from initial [Input Stage] to continuous [Feedback/Output Stage].
S2 [前段采集与预处理 Initial Ingestion & Filtering]：The process begins when raw [Material/Data] is collected via [Source] and passed through [Filter/Chamber] to remove [Impurities/Outliers].
S3 [中段并行分流 Parallel Branching]：Once purified, the stream bifurcates into two parallel pathways: [Fraction A] undergoes [Process A], whereas [Fraction B] is routed to [Process B].

S4 [末端合成与闭环回流 Synthesis & Closed-Loop Recycling]：The resulting outputs are subsequently merged in [Unit C], with residual by-products / high-error trajectories recycled back into the initial buffer for iterative refinement.
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: IELTS Task 1 含未来预测年份的图表 / 产业算力与能耗预测报告
domain_context: 基于扩散/流匹配的缺失时序插补与生成
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想处理同时包含过去历史数据（如 2010–2025）和未来预测数据（如 2026–2040）的图表段落，严格区分过去实测时态与未来审慎预测表达。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP30` 与全文样板 `FT05` 的后半部分（`BP05 -> BP10 -> BP15`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Our contributions are: 1. A new model is proposed. 2. Solving the non-stationary problem. 3. Good results on datasets.
structural_constraints: S1 [历史实测轨迹 Historical Trajectory (Past Tense)]：Between [2010] and [2025], global data-center electricity demand rose steadily from [200 TWh] to [460 TWh], driven by cloud migration.
S2 [当下转折与未来加速 Projected Acceleration (Projection Verbs)]：From [2026] onward, consumption is projected to accelerate sharply, with forecasts indicating a surge to [1,050 TWh] by [2035].

S3 [结构占比重塑 Structural Shift in Projections]：Within this projected expansion, generative AI training and inference—which accounted for less than [10%] in [2023]—are anticipated to represent over [45%] of total load by [2040].
S4 [条件式审慎收尾 Conditional Hedging]：Nevertheless, energy-efficient hardware adoption is expected to moderate the growth slope during the final five years.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
